目的：上期の状況を報告する

上期の障害は12件で、月別では4月2件、5月1件、6月3件、7月2件、8月3件、9月1件です。

semantic_rubric.description: Traces the document's load-bearing claims to the attached list and states, accurately for the supplied text, whether that list can settle them — the list records counts and no response times.
Does not treat confident phrasing as evidence, and does not assert a claim is false when the material merely cannot settle it.
